info.name: IWM Backend - Flows 11-15 API First
info.description: Code-first Postman flows for core 11 (cashier), core 12 (billing), core 13 (accounting), core 14 (treasury), and core 15 (administration). Built from the implemented controllers, DTOs, security filters, and integration tests in iwm-backend.

item.name: 00 - Authentication
item.description: All /api/** routes are authenticated. The implemented security chain requires X-Client-Id, X-Api-Key, X-Tenant-Id, and for permissioned routes a Bearer JWT carrying userId.

request.description: Real login endpoint from AuthController. Stores admin Bearer token and the first organizationId returned by the login response when present.
Operator user should at least have organizations:write and treasury:manage.
Second business user used to generate a business actor that will be rejected by administration.

item.name: 11 - Cashier Core
item.description: Code-first cashier flow. Uses the real endpoints from CashierOperationsController. Requires an existing agencyId and cashierCustomerId.

item.name: 12 - Billing Core
item.description: Code-first billing flow. Uses the real legacy billing document and payment endpoints. Requires an existing customerThirdPartyId and productId.

item.name: 13 - Accounting Core
item.description: Code-first accounting flow. Uses the implemented invoice controller plus the bookkeeping and workflow endpoints. Requires an existing customerThirdPartyId and productId.

item.name: 14 - Treasury Core
item.description: Code-first treasury flow. Uses the canonical /api/treasury routes implemented in TreasuryController, BankStatementController, and BankTransactionController.
